description: Defines singleton pattern classes and related utilities within the Thunder::Core namespace, including Singleton base class, SingletonType template, SingletonProxyType, and UniqueType for managing singleton instances.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class for singleton pattern, manages registration and disposal of singleton instances.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class deriving from Singleton, implements singleton pattern for a specific type with thread safety and lifecycle management.

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing proxy-based singleton management.

classes.name: UniqueType
classes.description: Template class for managing a singleton with reference counting and thread safety.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the singleton implementation.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance, with overloads for default construction and parameterized creation.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the singleton instance with optional parameters.

methods.name: Drop
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes singleton if no longer used.
